historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR cannot be computed over 3 years: FY2022 shareholders' equity was -4,847 (pre-IPO preferred shares carried as liabilities, converted at the Oct-2023 listing). Owner FCF (reported FCF - SBC - finance income, per the contract identity) was -1,366.6 FY2022, -203.2 FY2023, +125.2 FY2024, +336.2 FY2025: a loss-to-profit inflection, not a compounding series, so no FCF CAGR is meaningful. scenario_narratives.base: SEA leadership compounds (38.1% share, falling cost/parcel), China stays a rational #5 under anti-involution, Other Markets stay profitable; EBITDA margin 10% -> 12.5%, capex 4.8% -> 3%, owner FCF margin matures to ~5%.
scenario_narratives.bull: SEA playbook replicates in LatAm/Middle East, S.F. partnership opens cross-border and Europe, China pricing recovers; margin 15% by year 10 and double-digit growth through year 6.
scenario_narratives.bear: China price war returns, platform-captive logistics claw back SEA share, New Markets need more capital, capex stays elevated; margin stalls at 9-10% and growth fades to 3%.

valuation_philosophy.summary: A capital-intensive, volume-driven logistics operator valued on the cash it will keep after SBC, lease cash and reinvestment, not on adjusted EBITDA. Today it reinvests almost everything (FY2025 owner FCF after lease cash US$64.5m on US$12.2bn revenue), so the value is a bet on the margin and capex paths of the next decade; the model charges that uncertainty through a 25% bear weight and a USD WACC above the arithmetic build, and treats the HK$4.65bn convertible as debt, the S.F. stake as an asset at its 30-June mark, and the level-3 related-party investments at haircuts.
key_risks_to_valuation: China price competition: China is ~55% of H1 FY2026 revenue at the thinnest margin; a renewed price war takes the group margin back to the bear path.
Platform concentration: Shopee, TikTok Shop, Temu, SHEIN, Pinduoduo and Lazada can move volume to captive or rival carriers and set per-parcel pricing.
Capex guided at US$700-800m for FY2026 with lease liabilities up 38% in six months; owner FCF is near zero until intensity falls.
Balance-sheet items valued by management: Yimi Global related-party CB (US$427m, level 3, -US$53m in H1), Windfall fund (US$185m), JET Global preferred-share buy-out (US$464m).
Multi-currency EM exposure (IDR, THB, VND, PHP, BRL, RMB) against USD reporting and a USD-built WACC.
WVR structure: founder control over strategic transactions; the S.F. cross-shareholding was done at HK$10.10 against an HK$11.74 market price.

inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted at 30 June 2026: 9,762.827m issued (971.390m Class A + 8,791.437m Class B, H1 FY2026 note 23) less 99.318m treasury shares (cancelled July 2026) plus 68.2m unvested award shares (diluted-EPS adjustment, note 13). The 2026 Convertible Bonds (max 319.6m Class B at HK$14.55, 3.2%) are OUT of the money at the quote and are carried as debt at face instead; they are not added to the count. Held FLAT: SBC is expensed in the flows, and the HK$2.0bn open-market repurchase plan (US$102.7m spent in H1 FY2026) is funding the flat count. The 822m-share issue to S.F. Holding on 9 June 2026 was genuine non-SBC issuance and is already IN the 30-June count, with its matching asset (the 4.29% S.F. stake) in the equity bridge.
inputs.net_debt_note: USD m at 30 June 2026 (H1 FY2026 interim balance sheet). total_debt = borrowings 2,665.357 (non-current 1,678.937 + current 986.420, note 26) + 2026 Convertible Bonds at FACE HK$4,650m / 7.8473 = 592.6 (carried at 479.7 liability + 114.6 equity component; zero coupon, 3.68% implied yield to 2033, so the redemption amount is what is owed if not converted). cash = cash and cash equivalents 1,413.815 + current FVTPL bank wealth-management products and other short-term investments 1,289.443 (note 21, level 2, redeemable). Restricted cash 247.5 (pledged as guarantee deposits for borrowings) is EXCLUDED, a conservative choice worth ~US$0.025/share. Lease liabilities 685.1 (491.4 + 193.7) are EXCLUDED from debt because the lease cash is charged inside the flows (lease_treatment).
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report, adjusted-EBITDA reconciliation / cash flow add-back 'share-based compensation expenses related to employee benefit expenses' US$112.551m. No cash taxes on equity awards are disclosed (0). The FY2023 US$1,258m 'share-based payments related to equity transactions' was an IPO-year pre-listing charge and is excluded from the series as non-recurring.
inputs.buyback_note: FY2025 financing outflow 'repurchase of ordinary shares' US$45.148m; H1 FY2026 US$102.676m (99.3m shares). Buyback cap raised to HK$2.0bn on 25 June 2026. Buybacks are value-neutral here (they fund the flat count); the number is recorded for auditability.
inputs.fx_note: Statements and all flows are USD (the Group's presentation currency; functional currencies RMB, IDR, VND, THB, PHP, BRL etc.). The HKEX quote is HKD. Per-share values are computed in USD and converted at USD/HKD 7.8473 (Yahoo HKD=X, 2026-10-16; the HKD is pegged in a 7.75-7.85 band so the rate is stable). No dual listing exists for a parity check; the HKD denomination of the quote is confirmed by the S.F. Holding subscription at HK$10.10/share and the HK$14.55 CB conversion price in the same interim report. Unsuffixed intrinsic_value / weighted_iv are in HKD, comparable to current_price; *_usd twins are the model currency.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in USD, the currency of the flows: US 10y risk-free ~4.2%, ERP 5.0%, beta ~1.3 for a multi-country emerging-market logistics operator with a short profit history and a WVR structure -> cost of equity ~10.7%. After-tax cost of debt ~3.5% (bank borrowings at ~4-5%, zero-coupon CB at 3.68%, 25% tax), debt weight ~22% of enterprise value (US$3.3bn debt vs ~US$11.5bn market cap). WACC = 0.78 x 10.7% + 0.22 x 3.5% = 9.1%, rounded UP to 9.5% for emerging-market country/currency risk, which is systematic and belongs in the rate, not in the scenarios. Same WACC in all three scenarios; operational risk (China price war, platform concentration, New Markets execution) is charged once, in the flows and weights.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B), leases as operating cost. The full IFRS-16 lease cash (FY2025: principal 241.143 + interest 30.595 = 271.7, 2.23% of revenue; H1 FY2026 127.4 + 19.7 = 147.1, 1.92%) is charged inside EBIT via lease_cost_pct_path, lease liabilities (685.1) are EXCLUDED from net debt, and da_pct_path is D&A EX right-of-use depreciation (FY2025 482.943 total less 216.923 ROU = 266.0, 2.19% of revenue) so the lease is not charged twice. Short-term lease expense (US$94m H1 FY2026) is already inside adjusted EBITDA and needs no adjustment.
inputs.nci_treatment: Charged once, in the flows. Reported NCI is NEGATIVE (-295.8 at 30 June 2026: the minorities' share of accumulated start-up losses), so deducting the book NCI would ADD value, which is wrong; it is set to 0 in the bridge instead and ~1.5pp is added to cash_tax_rate_path as profit leakage (NCI share of profit: 12% FY2025, 3.3% H1 FY2026). The New Markets minority is separately deducted at its liability value: JET Global Series A / A-1 preferred shares US$464.4m (FVTPL, under the 25 Dec 2025 buy-out agreement) and the JNT KSA share-redemption liability US$85.9m.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF component DCF (operating company: express delivery / e-commerce logistics, 13 countries, ~97% per-parcel delivery fees). First valuation of this ticker; no memory entry. Non-US adaptations applied: USD flows vs HKD quote (fx_note), lease treatment (B), NCI in flows, matching-asset rule (finance income stripped, cash-like and investment assets in the bridge). FY0 is FY2025 (31 Dec); year 1 is FY2026, for which H1 is already reported (revenue +39.5%, adj. EBITDA margin 9.5%). Calibration: FY2025 EBITDA 1,049.1 - SBC 112.6 - lease 271.7 - D&A ex-ROU 266.0 = 398.8 unlevered post-lease EBIT, which ties to reported EBIT 366.0 (PBT 263.4 + net finance cost 102.6) plus lease interest 30.6 = 396.6. Owner FCF FY2025 on the contract identity (reported FCF 494.4 - SBC 112.6 - finance income 45.6) is 336.2; after lease cash it is 64.5, i.e. the business is currently reinvesting almost all of its cash generation (FY2026 capex guided US$700-800m vs 593.6 in FY2025). The house/street band is narrow (SBC ~0.9% of revenue) but non-zero, so band_position is reported. The FY2025 'fair value change of preferred-share liabilities' and FVTPL gains/losses (Yimi CB -53m H1 FY2026) are below adjusted EBITDA and outside the flows.

bear.narrative: The China price war re-ignites once the policy push fades (China adjusted EBIT already fell from 147 to 94 in FY2025), Shopee's SPX and TikTok's captive logistics take back SEA share and force revenue/parcel down faster than cost/parcel, New Markets need another funding round, and capex stays at ~4.5% of revenue to defend the network; margin stalls at 9-10%, growth fades to 3% by year 8 and the business never earns much above its cost of capital.

base.growth_note: FY2026 +32%: H1 reported +39.5% (volume +25.1%, revenue/parcel +13% on China anti-involution pricing and SEA mix), H2 against a tougher base ~+26%. Then SEA (+71% H1 volume, 38.1% share) and Other Markets (+120%) decelerate as share gains mature, China grows high-single-digit; blended 20% -> 4% by year 10.
base.margin_note: Adjusted EBITDA margin (company definition, pre-SBC, post-IFRS-16): FY2024 7.6%, FY2025 8.6%, H1 FY2026 9.5% (H2 is seasonally stronger: FY2025 H1 7.9% / H2 9.2%). Path 10.0% -> 12.5% as SEA cost/parcel keeps falling, China stabilises, New Markets scale past breakeven. ZTO-type China network-partner margins (~30%) are NOT assumed; J&T is a #5 China player and a direct-operation-heavy SEA operator.
base.capex_note: FY2025 593.6 (4.9% of revenue); FY2026 guided US$700-800m (~4.7% on the modelled revenue; H1 actual 425.9). Tapers to 3.0% as the Guangzhou mega-hub and SEA automation roll-out complete; terminal capex 3.0% vs D&A 2.6% leaves 0.4pp of growth capex for 3% growth.
base.tax_note: Cash tax FY2025 73.6 on PBT 263.4 (28%); H1 FY2026 61.3 on 295.1 (21%). Statutory 25% China, 22% Indonesia, 20% Vietnam/Thailand, 25% Philippines; on unlevered EBIT the blended rate is ~24%, plus ~1.5pp NCI profit leakage -> 26%. Tax is on EBIT ex interest; the debt shield lives in the after-tax cost of debt.
base.wc_note: 0%: advances from customers (357.5) and payables (825.1 + accruals 1,468.7) roughly offset receivables (1,206.1); FY2025 OCF implied ~+67 WC inflow, H1 FY2026 ~-57 outflow.
base.narrative: SEA leadership compounds (share 38.1% and rising, cost/parcel falling), China holds a #5 position with pricing rationalised by the anti-involution policy, Other Markets stay profitable and grow off a small base; group adjusted EBITDA margin reaches ~12.5% by year 10 and capex intensity tapers from ~4.8% to 3%, so owner FCF margin matures to ~5% of revenue.

bull.narrative: The SEA playbook replicates in Latin America and the Middle East (Mercado Libre, SHEIN, Temu, TikTok volumes), the S.F. Holding partnership opens cross-border and European lanes, China revenue/parcel keeps recovering under anti-involution and the Guangzhou hub drives cost/parcel to industry-best; margin reaches 15% (still half of a China network-partner incumbent) and growth stays double-digit through year 6.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 16x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 25%: group profitability only dates from FY2024, China (62% of revenue) halved its EBIT in FY2025 before policy intervened, the largest customers are a handful of platforms with their own logistics arms, gearing is 64-68% of assets and the WVR structure leaves minorities no say over capital allocation (the S.F. swap, the Yimi related-party CB). Bull cut from 35% to 25% because it needs three independent things to go right at once: China pricing to hold, Latin America to repeat SEA, and the S.F. partnership to produce cross-border volume. Base 50%.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
sanity_check.known_bug_note: sanity_check.py multiplies the FY-end price by inputs.fx_rate (7.8473, defined HKD->USD by dividing) instead of dividing, double-converting the HKD price and inflating implied/historical P/B and EV/EBITDA by another ~7.8x. This is the documented systemic fx-rate-direction bug (memory: sanity-check-fx-rate-direction-systemic-bug), not specific to this ticker. Hand-recomputed FY2025 anchor (price/fx=10.17 vs 8,840.1m shares): P/B ~28.5x, P/Sales ~7.4x, EV/EBITDA ~85.7x (ex net debt) -- still rich (first full profitable post-IPO year on a thin EBITDA/equity base) but nowhere near the 190x/2000x the script reported. The passed:true verdict happens to survive because the inflated figures stayed on the same side of the trip thresholds; it is not a reliable confirmation.
